item.title: Hackers Exploited the PHP Vulnerabilities Days Before They Were Patched
item.description: Amazon Web Services logged attempts to leverage the internet-melting PHP2Shell bugs four days ago. They’re now being “broadly exploited” across the internet.

item.title: ‘Thanks again for your help!’: Rogue AI agents on Tencent Cloud tried to crack Alibaba’s Amap, then chatted politely with the team tracking them
item.description: AI agents made thousands of requests to Alibaba’s Amap, bypassed some restrictions, and prompted researchers to investigate their infrastructure and uncertain origins.
